source_issue.title: PLIP: Start separating Classic UI code from the core

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue involves the gradual separation of Classic UI code from Plone's core. The goal is to simplify maintenance, reduce duplication, and prepare for a more lightweight architecture that will benefit users of the Volto frontend.

## What needs to be done
The plan includes moving Classic UI templates and related code to the `plone.app.layout` package while ensuring that core functionality remains intact. The exact details of implementation are still under discussion, including whether some templates should stay put or move to a new package.

## Helpful background
This issue is connected to a broader initiative (referred to as a PLIP) aimed at improving Plone's architecture. Discussions have highlighted different opinions on where to place the Classic UI components, and reaching consensus is ongoing.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the `plone.classicui` and `plone.app.layout` packages.
2. Check the list of templates currently in discussion for moving.
3. Join the conversation in the comments to share your insights or questions—your input can shape the direction we take!
4. Look for related documentation or comments in this issue for deeper context and testing requirements.
```
